en.name: AGCleaner
en.short_description: Find duplicate contacts and identical photos. Clear the app's own cache.
en.subtitle: Duplicate contacts & photos
en.description:
AGCleaner finds duplicates. It does not claim to do anything else.

DUPLICATE CONTACTS
AGCleaner reads your address book and groups the entries that describe the same person, matching on phone number, email address or name. Each group tells you which of the three it matched on, so you can judge it yourself. AGCleaner never edits, merges or deletes a contact — it asks for read access only, shows you what it found, and stops there.

IDENTICAL PHOTOS
AGCleaner compares photos by content, not by appearance. Two photos are listed together only when their files are byte-for-byte identical, confirmed by a SHA-256 digest of the actual bytes. There is no "98% similar" score anywhere in the app, because nothing in it computes one, and a merely similar photo is a different photo. One copy in every group is always kept. You choose what goes, your device asks you to confirm it, and the total you are shown afterwards is the size of exactly the files the system reported it removed.

APP CACHE
The Cache tab measures AGCleaner's own temporary directory and can empty it. The figure is a real byte count taken by walking that directory, and the amount freed is the difference measured after the delete. No other app is touched.

WHAT IT CANNOT DO
AGCleaner cannot free system memory, cannot clear another app's data, and cannot report your device's total free storage. Apps on iOS and Android are not permitted to do those things, so AGCleaner does not show a gauge pretending otherwise.

WHAT LEAVES YOUR DEVICE
Your photos, contacts and files never do. Matching, hashing and deleting all happen on the device, and every photo shown in the results is one of your own files. There is no account, no sign-in and no purchase.
The app does send anonymous diagnostics to Google Firebase: crash reports, performance measurements and basic usage statistics, so that problems can be found and fixed. They carry no name, no contact detail and no photo or file content, and they are not used for advertising.

ADS
AGCleaner is free and shows ads from Google AdMob: a banner below the tab content and, occasionally, a full-screen ad between tabs. Google may use device identifiers to serve and measure those ads. The app does not track you across other companies' apps or websites, and where the law requires consent (for example in the EEA, the UK and Switzerland) Google asks for it first; you can change that choice later from the Privacy choices button in the header.

The interface is available in twelve languages, switchable from the globe in the header.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
AGCleaner finds duplicates. It does not claim to do anything else.

Intended audience:
Duplicate contacts & photos

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
Google Firebase (Crashlytics, Analytics, Performance Monitoring, Remote Config), for anonymous crash reports, performance measurements and usage statistics.
Google AdMob (ads): a banner below the tab content and a frequency-capped interstitial between tabs, requested only after Google's User Messaging Platform consent check. No App Tracking Transparency prompt is shown because the app does not track.
No photo, contact or file content is sent anywhere: duplicate detection, hashing and deletion run entirely on the device. The app has no backend, no account and no sign-in.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app follows the device language for 12 locales (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish), but translation is partial: shared labels are translated, while most screen text is in English only. Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
